content.comment_body: Sales and delivery release of firmware [version_no] for [product_name] ([article_no]) and [product_name] ([article_no]) including free download is now available. Currently, the website is accessible only in German because changing to English is not functioning. The new firmware offers updated features and corrections, such as enhanced monitoring and control via outgoing and incoming calls, SNTP server capability on LAN, configurable VPN ports for connecting additional devices, increased user and group limits, and new SMS/e-mail placeholders for GPS data. Security improvements include default HTTPS-only access and better multi-SMS handling. The processing time for telegrams sent from [product_name] is now configurable, and signal placeholder corrections were made for digital inputs. General advice is to use the latest firmware to ensure ongoing security and functionality, as older versions stop receiving support after a successor is released.

I contacted the webmaster regarding the dysfunctional language selection. Today I received a reply: The content you referenced is currently only available in German, which results in an error when attempting to switch the site to English. Best regards, [user_name], Online Support Team

analysis.insight_summary: The release notes announce new firmware for [product_name] modules with explanations of added features and bug fixes. Yet, users are facing a usability issue—the official website offers the information only in German and the language switch to English does not work. This hinders non-German-speaking users from accessing technical content and firmware updates.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the official website for [company_name] products to have a reliable language switch feature, providing access to key information and downloads in English.
